beats: Artem's sugar trend lived only in his CareLink app — the room's TV showed just his number, not whether it moved.
A first fix crammed a full chart under the calendar and it ate the screen.
I redrew the line across the bottom of his own camera photo instead.
White means in range, red low, yellow high — the room reads his day at a glance.
Four redesigns in one evening, before the shape finally felt right.
